title: The sound where sand pours from the hands, between the fingers
usageStatement: The source page allows commercial and personal use, describes the files as free and royalty-free with no attribution required. Not CC0.
processing: Constant gain +24 dB because the original recording is very quiet; MP3 at 44.1 kHz / 128 kbps. No EQ, compression or pitch changes. Playback loops seconds 0.02 to 2.30 with a 40 ms seam crossfade and pickup-driven gain envelope.
